result.rationale: Copia is a valid Carlyle U.S. infrastructure PortCo. Carlyle's sale to EQT Infrastructure VII was signed on 2026-07-09 but unclosed, so Carlyle remains current; the production fund attribution lacks direct support.

identityResolution.boundary: Standalone platform. Only Birch Infrastructure's renewable-energy business merged into Copia; Tenaska supplied a development pipeline. Projects beneath Copia are not separate manager-level PortCos.

operatingResolution.profile: Developer-owner-operator of U.S. solar, storage, dispatchable thermal, transmission/substation and data-center campuses for utilities, public power, hyperscalers and industrial/corporate users.
operatingResolution.footprint: Western high-voltage positions with expansion toward eastern digital hubs.
operatingResolution.scale: Company overview: >2.6 GW operating/under construction, >15 GW data centers, >25 GW solar/storage and 7 GW gas; EQT's July 9 release stated >9 GW data centers.
operatingResolution.scope: Physical infrastructure, not debt, public securities, LP exposure or a subsidiary already counted elsewhere.

acquisitionExitCheck.entry: Carlyle announced the wholly owned platform on 2021-07-21; exact legal entry date is undisclosed.
acquisitionExitCheck.merger: The 2022 combination covered Birch's renewable-energy business and did not displace Carlyle attribution.
acquisitionExitCheck.pendingExit: Sale to EQT Infrastructure VII announced 2026-07-09; conditional and expected to close by end-2026.
acquisitionExitCheck.closingCheck: No party closing release found through 2026-08-19; Carlyle's adviser still labels the sale pending.
acquisitionExitCheck.other: No later completed sale, transfer, recapitalization, bankruptcy or rebrand found.

milestones.event: Carlyle publicly launched Copia as a wholly owned U.S. infrastructure platform.
Copia combined with Birch Infrastructure's renewable-energy business.
Carlyle agreed to sell Copia to EQT Infrastructure VII; closing remained conditional.

beforeAfterChanges: Add signed-pending outbound sale to EQT Infrastructure VII; expected close by end-2026.
Keep Carlyle active as CURRENT_OWNER_PENDING_EXIT; do not activate EQT before closing.
Replace Carlyle Global Infrastructure Opportunity Fund with NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED.
Replace headquarters 'Western United States' with Dana Point, California.
Expand profile beyond solar/storage to integrated power-and-digital campuses; update the $300 million facility to its $575 million December 2025 upsize.
excludedOrDuplicateCandidates: Birch Infrastructure: do not merge the full entity; only its renewable-energy business combined with Copia.
Tenaska: not a predecessor PortCo; Copia acquired only a development pipeline.
Harquahala I/II, Centennial Flats, Maricopa Energy Center and other Copia projects: exclude as separate manager-level rows.
unresolvedQuestions: Exact Copia legal entity name: NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED; no material display-identity uncertainty.
Carlyle fund/vehicle: NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED; remove the unsupported fund assignment.
Pending-sale stake, consideration and exact closing date: NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED; monitor for closing.
result.recommendedListAction: Retain Copia Power on Carlyle Infrastructure's active North American list, add the signed-pending outbound sale to EQT Infrastructure VII, and keep Carlyle current until closing is verified.
